test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

The new student hails from the ________ societies of the Eastern India. (affluent)
solution:
The correct answer is: **wealthy**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Affluent **means having a great deal of money; wealthy or prosperous. (समृद्ध)

 
 
• **Example**: *The affluent neighbourhood was filled with mansions and luxury cars.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Wealthy **means having a great deal of wealth or money; rich.
